title: Central Maui Little League — Tee-Ball / 2027 Registration
time: Opens Thursday, October 15, 2026; closes Sunday, November 15, 2026
details: Registration is open Thursday, October 15 through Sunday, November 15, 2026. Tee-Ball is $100 for birthdates September 2020–August 2023. Register online at the league site.
instructions: All registrations must be completed online at the league site. Registration for Juniors (12–14) and Seniors (14–16) will be held at a later date.
scheduleNote: This window also includes Coach Pitch (birthdates September 2018–August 2020, $105), Minors (September 2016–August 2018, $125), Majors (September 2014–August 2016, $130) and Intermediate / 50-70 (September 2013–August 2015, $130).
